c1-13-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Growth and Expectations
c1-13-01.scenario: Károly shows you an economic report. It says the economy grew by three percent, more than the experts expected.
c1-13-01.prompt: Tell Károly what the report says about growth and expectations.
cues: Say how much the economy grew
Say that it was better than expected
c1-13-01.target: A gazdaság a várakozásokat felülmúlva három százalékkal nőtt.
c1-13-01.english: Exceeding expectations, the economy grew by three percent.
c1-13-01.canDo: I can compare figures in an economic report with a participle (*összevetve a tavalyi évvel, a várakozásokat felülmúlva*).

c1-13-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Why the Rate Stayed
c1-13-02.scenario: Károly asks why the central bank kept the base rate unchanged.
c1-13-02.prompt: Tell Károly the purpose of the decision.
c1-13-02.target: Az árstabilitás megőrzése érdekében a jegybank szinten tartotta az alapkamatot.
c1-13-02.english: To preserve price stability, the central bank kept the base rate unchanged.
c1-13-02.canDo: I can explain a central bank decision with its purpose (*az árstabilitás megőrzése érdekében*).

c1-13-03.title: Communicative Challenge: If the Debt Grows
c1-13-03.scenario: Károly asks what happens to the public debt if the government does not cut spending.
c1-13-03.prompt: Tell Károly what follows, with a condition.
cues: Say what happens to the debt
c1-13-03.target: Amennyiben a kormány nem csökkenti a kiadásokat, úgy az államadósság nő.
c1-13-03.english: If the government does not cut spending, the public debt grows.
c1-13-03.canDo: I can state a fiscal condition with *amennyiben …, úgy …*.

c1-13-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Price-Wage Spiral
c1-13-04.scenario: Károly asks what a price-wage spiral is.
cues: Say what that does to prices
c1-13-04.target: A bérek nőnek, ami az árakat is növeli: ez az ár-bér spirál.
c1-13-04.english: Wages rise, which also raises prices: this is the price-wage spiral.
c1-13-04.canDo: I can say what one price change causes with *ami* (*a bérek nőnek, ami az árakat is növeli*).

c1-13-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Why the Firm Does Not Worry
c1-13-05.scenario: You have read the text about Kornai János. Károly asks what it says about loss-making firms.
c1-13-05.prompt: Tell Károly what the text says about these firms.
cues: Say what the firms do not fear
c1-13-05.target: A szöveg szerint az állam kisegíti a veszteséges vállalatokat, ezért azok nem félnek a csődtől.
c1-13-05.english: According to the text, the state rescues the loss-making firms, so they do not fear bankruptcy.
c1-13-05.canDo: I can explain Kornai's soft budget constraint in a few sentences.

c1-13-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Summing Up the Report
c1-13-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks you to sum up the economic report you have read.
c1-13-consolidation.prompt: Say how the economy did and what limits the government.
cues: Say the economy grew more than expected
Name what narrows the government's room
c1-13-consolidation.target: A gazdaság a várakozásokat felülmúlva nőtt, de a nagy kamatteher szűkíti a költségvetési mozgásteret.
c1-13-consolidation.english: The economy grew, exceeding expectations, but the large interest burden narrows the fiscal room for manoeuvre.
c1-13-consolidation.canDo: I can compare figures in an economic report with a participle.
